content.value_statement: Statistical modeling often requires precise model choice, diagnostics, and inference. This skill guides statsmodels workflows for regression, GLM, time series, and discrete outcomes.
actual_capabilities: Guides OLS, WLS, GLS, quantile regression, and mixed effects workflows.
Explains GLM family selection, link functions, and coefficient interpretation.
Covers Logit, Probit, multinomial, count, and zero-inflated models.
Supports ARIMA, SARIMAX, VAR, stationarity checks, and forecast diagnostics.
Details residual, influence, heteroskedasticity, normality, and autocorrelation tests.
Helps compare models with AIC, BIC, likelihood ratio tests, and validation metrics.
limitations: Requires user supplied data, variables, and modeling goals.
Does not replace statistical judgment or study design review.
Examples may need package versions and imports adjusted locally.
Results depend on data quality, assumptions, and correct model specification.

use_cases.title: Validate regression models
use_cases.description: Fit linear models, test assumptions, review influence, and decide when robust standard errors are needed.

use_cases.title: Estimate interpretable effects
use_cases.description: Use econometric models, hypothesis tests, and model comparisons to support coefficient-level inference.

use_cases.title: Forecast time series
use_cases.description: Build ARIMA or SARIMAX workflows with stationarity checks, residual diagnostics, and prediction intervals.

prompt_templates.title: Fit OLS Regression
prompt_templates.prompt: Fit an OLS regression for [outcome] using [predictors] in my pandas data. Explain the intercept, key diagnostics, and findings in plain language.

prompt_templates.title: Model Binary Outcomes
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a Logit or Probit model for [binary outcome]. Report odds or marginal effects, classification metrics, and assumption checks.

prompt_templates.title: Forecast a Time Series
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze [time series] with statsmodels. Check stationarity, identify ARIMA or SARIMAX orders, compare candidates, and produce forecasts with intervals.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Model Strategies
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare candidate models for [analysis goal]. Use diagnostics, AIC, BIC, validation results, and statistical reasoning to recommend a final approach.

output_examples.input: Fit an OLS model with robust standard errors and review assumptions.
output: Recommended workflow: fit OLS with an intercept, then inspect coefficient estimates and residual behavior.
Use robust HC3 standard errors if variance is not constant.
Review leverage and Cook distance before interpreting important predictors.

output_examples.input: Forecast monthly sales for the next year with uncertainty.
output: Test stationarity and identify seasonal structure with ACF and PACF plots.
Compare SARIMAX candidates with AIC, BIC, and residual diagnostics.
Return 12 forecast periods with prediction intervals and validation metrics.

output_examples.input: Choose a model for count data with many zero values.
output: Start with Poisson, then check dispersion and zero frequency.
Use Negative Binomial when counts are overdispersed.
Evaluate zero-inflated models when structural zeros are plausible.

best_practices: Add an intercept deliberately and document any reason for excluding it.
Check residuals, influence, convergence, and variance assumptions after fitting.
Report effect sizes, confidence intervals, and the uncertainty method used.
anti_patterns: Using OLS for binary or count outcomes without checking alternatives.
Choosing models only by p-values while ignoring diagnostics and assumptions.
Interpreting forecasts or causal effects without validation and domain context.

faq.question: Can this skill run statsmodels automatically?
faq.answer: It can guide code and analysis steps. Execution depends on the host tool, available data, and installed Python packages.

faq.question: Which model families does it cover?
faq.answer: It covers linear models, GLMs, discrete choice models, count models, time series models, and diagnostic tests.

faq.question: Does it choose the correct model for me?
faq.answer: It helps narrow choices from outcome type, assumptions, and diagnostics. You should confirm the model matches the research question.

faq.question: Can it produce publication-ready summaries?
faq.answer: It helps structure coefficient tables, uncertainty reporting, diagnostics, and interpretation for review-ready statistical summaries.

faq.question: How does it support time series analysis?
faq.answer: It guides stationarity checks, ACF and PACF review, ARIMA or SARIMAX selection, forecasting, and residual diagnostics.

faq.question: Is it suitable for causal inference?
faq.answer: It can support regression-based causal workflows and diagnostics. It does not prove identification or replace study design review.
